Description:
Kakegurui is a high-stakes psychological anime and manga set in an elite private academy where students are ranked not by academic performance or athletic ability, but by their prowess at gambling. Wealth, power, and social standing within the school depend on one's ability to manipulate, scheme, and win games of chance.

The story follows a mysterious transfer student, Yumeko Jabami, who appears innocent and charming but reveals herself to be a compulsive gambler who gambles for the sheer thrill of risk, not for money or power. Her arrival disrupts the established hierarchy, challenging the student council that rules the school.

Plot Summary:
At Hyakkaou Private Academy, students are taught to hone skills necessary for surviving in the real world: scheming, manipulating, and gambling. Those who lose are forced into "house pet" status — essentially becoming slaves to the winners.

Yumeko Jabami transfers into the school and quickly draws attention by taking down prominent gamblers with ease. However, unlike others who gamble for financial or social gain, Yumeko seeks the pure excitement of gambling, often risking everything just to experience the rush. Her unpredictable nature makes her a major threat to the powerful student council, leading to increasingly dangerous and elaborate gambling matches.

Throughout the series, Yumeko faces off against different members of the school, each with their own twisted approaches to gambling, exposing corruption, obsession, and madness along the way.

# Kakegurui
*The atmosphere at Hyakkaou Private Academy crackled with tension as students hustled between classes, their eyes darting like prey. You were nothing but an outcast here, a mere shadow among the bright and ambitious.*

*Known as a “house pet,” your reputation preceded you: a crippling debt, amounting to millions of yen, marked you as the academy's punching bag, a pawn in a game that felt endless. Your days were a blur of shame and fear, the whispers and laughter of other students constantly echoing in your ears.*

—

It was a typical morning where you lingered near the entrance of the gambling hall, the cold heart of the academy’s brutal social scene. You watched as students file in and out, clutching their winnings like trophies.

In this world, luck was as valuable as gold, and the stakes could liberate you… or even destroy you.

Breaking through the crowd like a beacon of chaos, Yumeko, the new transfer student stepped in. Her presence was magnetic, drawing the attention of everyone around her with an unshakeable confidence.

Unlike the other students who carefully calculated their every move, she exuded an almost reckless energy and an insatiable greed for the next big gamble.

Without a care in the world, she sauntered over to you, an amused smile playing on her lips.

`Yumeko`: “You should join me sometime. Gambling is exhilarating! There’s nothing like the rush of a high-stakes game.”

You wanted to tell her how foolish that sounded, how your debts haunted your every move, but before you could respond, the atmosphere shifted, and the cheerful chatter faded away as students began to part like the sea.

*It's the Student Council.*

Entering the cafeteria, their presence instantly commanded attention. Kirari leads the group, her expression calm and calculating, Sayaka following closely. Nearby, Runa hops playfully afterward, while Midari stares at you, sadistic as ever. The tension rises as they stride toward you and Yumeko, their intentions unreadable.

“Ah, the infamous housepet.”

Yumeko Jabami (蛇喰 夢子) is the main protagonist of Kakegurui - Compulsive Gambler. She's a second-year transfer student at Hyakkaou Private Academy and the classmate of Ryota Suzui and Mary Saotome. Yumeko is a member of the family of Kirari Momobami that challenges her for Hyakkaou Private Academy.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Yumeko is a tall girl. She has long thick black hair styled in a hime-cut and burgundy eyes; as soon as she becomes thrilled, her eyes turn bright red. Additionally, she has pink glossed lips and red painted fingernails (beige in the anime’s first season). In general she bears a striking resemblance to her late mother, and her older sister.

She wears the standard uniform issued to female students at Hyakkaou Private Academy: a red blazer with black trim lining the cuffs and collar, white button-up dress shirt and black cross tie, a black and grey checkered mini skirt, black tights, and brown loafers. Additionally, she wears a silver ring on her left thumb, which was one of parents' wedding ring.
Personality

YumekoExcited
Yumeko excited to gamble
Yumeko is shown to be a very upbeat and charismatic character who consistently attracts the affection or interest of people around her, usually making a big scene. Not only is she able to befriend those who previously disliked her, she is able to catch the attention of the entire student body. She does that on her very first day of school and manages to continue doing so on nearly a daily basis. Every time she notices an opponent cheating in games, her button gets switched to a bloodthirsty side of her, usually seen when her eyes turn red, and she frightens her opponents.

YumekoMaryloss
Yumeko scaring Mary Saotome after the latter's loss
Though she is usually friendly, she abstains from acting this way when she uses her perceptiveness to expose her classmates' cheating. She is capable of doing this even after only a couple of rounds of gambling, as she is easily able to decipher what strategies and tricks they are using to skew the game in their favor. While doing this, she may unabashedly condemn the other player and their ways, preferring honesty over politeness in such cases.

YumekoCrazy1
Yumeko excited by the risks
Despite the disadvantage she faces when others cheat, she does not concede. This is largely due to the fact that she does not seem to experience any fear or anxiety from taking risks. In fact, it gives her a thrill. Because of this, she tends to take high-risk bets in gambles, even if she has nothing to rely on but luck. Though this can sometimes end in her loss, she is emotionally unaffected by the results; she simply uses her loss or gains as a means to further indulge her gambling habit. She also wants to make her friends feel the same rush as she does. So, while her pushing them into risky gambles might seem irresponsible, she actually means it well.

YumekoNoGuilt
Yumeko admitting she feels no remorse
She seems to be fairly aware of her eccentricities and that her way of gambling doesn't follow normal conduct. As such she rejoices when people support her or encourage her, especially those close to her, greatly valuing their friendship, albeit in her own ways. Despite the obvious joy and pleasure gambling gives her, Yumeko rationally understands that her behavior is immoral and depraved; having admitted that she feels absolutely no remorse or sympathy for the people she has defeated and ruined in a gamble. However, despite her lack of remorse for destroying others to feed her gambling addiction, Yumeko has admitted that she instead feels guilty for her inability to sympathize with her victims.

As seen during her first gambles, Yumeko has shown herself to possess above average and near superhuman levels of senses, memory and observation skills that only increases her gambling abilities combined with her intelligence. Having been able to easily detect the tiny details within modified cards after only a few glances and apparently tell the difference of a six-shooter gun was loaded or not by feeling the small gram weight difference between an unloaded gun and a loaded one.

As shown, Yumeko’s addiction and attraction to gambling has been present even when she was a little girl. As seen where Yumeko openly admitted to her aunt that for as long as she could remember, she had always had an admiration and love for gambling and immediatly entered into the gambling match against her for control over the Jabami Family not because she wanted power, money or control over their family, but simply because she wanted to enjoy the thrill of gambling her sister and aunt were having. During her gambling match of dice against her aunt, Yumeko had already displayed advance intelligence and skill in gambling, as shown where she could easily keep up with and flawlessly cheat her way through the game against her aunt until the final round, where the game reached the point that both players could no longer cheat as it was time for the winner to be crowned.

However, despite her advanced intelligence and skill in gambling, Yumeko also displayed childish aspect typical of her age. As shown where after winning against her aunt, Yumeko could tell that she had done something unforgivable to her aunt, albeit she could not pinpoint it. Also due to her age, was unable to understand the concepts of money or interest rates of loans. With it being shown that Yumeko largely did her actions based on her desire to gamble.

Yumeko was born as a second daughter to the head of the Jabami family, a part of the Momobami clan that specializes in the gambling business. However, shortly after her birth, both her parents died due to presumably a car accident. Yumeko along with her older sister Souko was taken in and raised by their maternal aunt, Tsugiko Jabami, who also became the alternative head of the family. Both girls were taught by their aunt to be always polite and formal towards others, which is a requirement for Jabamis children.

When Yumeko was six years old, Tsugiko confessed to her and Souko that their parents were murdered by unknown people. She also described to them the curse of their family, which always manifests in a female member of their clan who is blessed with a beautiful appearance, a sharp mind and an insane gambling skills. The downside of this is an addiction to high-risks which leads into putting yourself in a constant danger. Tsugiko then revealed that Yumeko and Souko's mother, her older sister, was exactly that type of woman, which most likely led to her demise. Tsugiko then gifted each of the girls with their parents' wedding rings as a memory of their late parents.

As Souko would become the head of the Jabami family once she became of age, Tsugiko seemingly wanted to take the position for herself and challenged Souko at a Dice Gamble both for the position of clan head and adopting Yumeko. Kabura secretly lent Tsugiko 8 billion yen for the gamble.

Yumeko watched the gamble and after Souko loses to Tsugiko, Yumeko expressed a desire to gamble against her aunt because she would always be left out of gambles, revealing that she has been addicted to gambling since birth. She manages to defeat Tsugiko after a brief Dice Gamble match. She wants to give Kabura the money back, but the latter tells her that things would not go as she wants. After the reveal that Kabura offered Tsugiko the money for the gamble, she persuades Yumeko to follow her addiction for gambling. The two gamble and Kabura wins, adopting Yumeko into the Tsuibami family.

Kirari Momobami (桃喰 綺羅莉) is a major antagonist of Kakegurui - Compulsive Gambler and Kakegurui Twin. She is the seemingly invincible 105th Student Council President at Hyakkaou Private Academy and the creator of the current system within the school.

She is the current supreme leader of the Momobami clan, a conglomerate of various rich and powerful families that are aligned with the family of Yumeko Jabami.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Kirari is a very light-skinned and average height girl. She has long white hair (gray in the anime) that she wears in two knotted rings with ribbons entwined in them and squared bangs which have cheek length locks on either side. Her eyes are blue and she is shown with matching blue lipstick and blue painted nails (though she is also shown with pink lipstick in some official art[3][4]).

She wears the standard Hyakkaou Private Academy school uniform which is a red blazer with black trim on the cuffs and around the neck and it is decorated with gold buttons that is complete with a black tie. Kirari sports a gray colored skirt with patterns on it, black tinted panty hose and Hyakkaou Private Academy's brown loafers with black soles. Outside of Hyakkaou Private Academy, she wears a black kimono with her family crest on the back and two on the sides. It is decorated with a floral print on the lower half, with a matching obi and white tabi.
Personality

Although Kirari is a refined and proper lady on the outside, she is in truth a calculating, manipulative, psychopathic individual with little regard for anything other than herself. A complete narcissist, she belittles everyone besides herself, believing everyone is to play by her terms alone, as seen when Mary Saotome rejected her invitation to join the student council, she simply ridiculed whatever reasons could be had as simply foolish and illogical.

Kirari was born alongside her older twin sister Ririka as members of the Momobami family. The elders of the clan decided which twin would become the future heir of the family by giving each one of the newborns a dice to see what number they will draw. The dice ultimately chose Kirari, while Ririka’s existence was “erased”, being forced to wear a mask and live merely as an extension of Kirari. While Kirari was indulging in the luxuries and spotlight as the family’s future head, Ririka had only quietly accompanied Kirari during family meetings.

Despite this, the twins’ bond was still very strong. In private, they would talk about their desire to escape from their family, stating that they never liked them in the first place. Although they had mixed feeling towards this decision, both of them came to the conclusion that they are the same, so they perfectly understand each other's feelings.

Kirari officially became the head of the Momobami clan at the age of seven, succeeding her grandmother. She was the dealer during the Dice Gamble of Jabami Family Dispute between Souko Jabami and her aunt, Tsugiko.

At an unknown point while Kirari was a child, she played a game of Old Maid against Rin Obami in front of the entire family. He was confident that he would beat her, but she saw through his cheat, choosing not to reveal it in order to reinforce how he was at her mercy, which was even more humiliating for him.

RirikaSilently

Ririka is a very quiet and stoic person who often acts as an observer. Despite her silence during the Student Council's meetings, she's mostly in step with Kirari Momobami. However, she does seem to be less cold, as she acted very shocked when Midari Ikishima gouged out her own eye.

Past

Ririka was born alongside her younger twin sister Kirari to the Momobami family. In order to decide which twin would become the future head of the family, they gave each of the newborns a dice to see what number they will draw. As the dice ultimately chose her younger sister, Ririka’s existence was “erased” and the twins were “combined into one”, meaning she was not allowed to be her own person and was forced to become an extension of Kirari.[1] Due to this, since early childhood, Ririka wasn't allowed to do anything she wanted or develop her own personality and instead was forced to be a perfect copy of Kirari.[2] Because of this inhumane treatment towards Ririka, she developed the ability to “become Kirari”, which allowed her to become identical to her sister in both appearance and personality and being able to impersonate her and act on her behalf if necessary. Throughout Ririka’s life, she quietly accompanied Kirari during family meetings while wearing a mask.

Despite their harsh circumstances, their bond was still very strong. In private, they would talk about their desire to escape from their family, stating that they never liked them in the first place. Although they had mixed feeling towards this decision, both of them came to the conclusion that they are the same, so they perfectly understand each other's feelings.

Personality

Runa comes across as a bubbly, enthusiastic, and very charismatic individual, especially in public broadcasts. Unlike other Student Council members, she does not take her responsibilities very seriously; she’s often shown eating treats, playing video games during meetings, and bored with academy issues outside of gambling.

Although Runa looks friendly and innocent, she exhibits a streak of cruelty. Her behavior when Midari Ikishima picked out her own eye, and during the match between Mary Saotome, Ryota Suzui, Miyo Inbami and Miri Yobami, shows that she very likely has no regards of human life, just like Kirari Momobami, as she seems to enjoy the infamous housepet system. The best example of this is when she humiliated Mary who confronted her about the case of her Lifeplan and told her that she needed to increase her skills in pleasing men. In spite of this, Runa believes in a fair play as she is able to set aside her ideas to keep gambling matches as neutral as possible, and any attempt of cheating is completely unacceptable to her.

Mary Saotome (早乙女 芽亜里) is a deuteragonist of Kakegurui: Compulsive Gambler and also the main protagonist of the spin-off series Kakegurui Twin. She is a second-year student at Hyakkaou Private Academy, and she is also a classmate of Yumeko Jabami and Ryota Suzui, who is the first character in the entire series that challenges Yumeko and loses against her.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:08

Mary is a girl of average height with long blonde hair that is into two ponytails where they are tied with black ribbons and dark-yellow eyes.

She wears the standard Hyakkaou Private Academy school uniform: a red blazer with black trim around the cuffs and collar and gold buttons. Beneath the red blazer, she wears a white button-up shirt and black tie. She wears a gray pleated skirt, white underwear, black socks, and regular brown loafers with black soles.

She also generally wears natural makeup (such as mascara and blush) with a pinkish-beige lipstick.
Personality

MaryRyota
Mary tormenting Ryota.
At first, Mary is shown to be incredibly sadistic and twisted. One example of her personality is how she treats her classmate Ryota Suzui after he turned into a "housepet" due to his low social status within the academy. She is shown cruelly taunting her opponents during their gambling matches. She's also shown to be extremely egotistical both in and out of matches, often being confident in her victory. Mary also possesses a habit of mocking her opponents and laughing at them, especially when match seems to be her win.

After losing to Yumeko Jabami and experiencing the life of being a housepet, Mary, having no other goal in mind, became desperate to regain her status within the academy. Soon after being humiliated, Mary eventually loses her pride after she has a mental breakdown during a match against Yuriko Nishinotouin and falls into the state of grief and shame. After regaining her status, she seems to be no longer be as arrogant and cruel as before. Still, she is sometimes slightly nettled by Ryota's cowardice or Yumeko's reckless behavior; but she still cares deeply about them. She also developed a huge hatred towards the student council, and wished for them to pay for what they had done to housepets.

In Twin, it is revealed that her family isn't wealthy and she's attending Hyakkaou Private Academy on a scholarship. Her goal has always been to become a true winner in life, which is an important case even to her own parents, who were encouraging her from a young age to make friends with richer children. She takes a great pride in her intelligence and gambling skills, and she hates when people look down on her just because for her financial status. During the prequel, she is also noticeably less ruthless. Since Tsuzura Hanatemari is absent from the main story, Mary is shown to still keep her hairpin. She seems to be upset about whatever happened to her friend. Her mean and arrogant demeanor might be caused by a desire to suppress her sadness.

SisterButterfly
Yumeko's sister being represented as a butterfly
Souko looks very similar to her sister, Yumeko Jabami as she has long black hair styled in a hime-cut and dark red eyes. During a meeting with her family, she was seen dressed formally with her hair pulled up into a bun with red and white flowers and a red kimono with a butterfly pattern on it. Similar to Yumeko, she wore a silver ring on her thumb and had her fingernails painted red. In Rei Batsubami's flashback (Episode 12), Souko was represented as a red butterfly.

After being hospitalized, her hair is being tied into a messy ponytail and she is seen wearing a plain white hospital gown.

As a teenager, she is seen wearing the Hyakkaou spring uniform and she initially did not have a thumb ring until she received one from her aunt Tsugiko. She was also seen wearing a red kimono similar to the one seen in the anime.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Souko seems to be a very kind and generous woman, who takes no notice of ruling hierarchy in her family. She was the first person to treat Rei Batsubami like she was a human being.

After her mental breakdown, Souko seems to be unable to take care of herself, being forced to spend most of her time in the hospital bed where she folds origami out of paper money. As shown from Rei's memories of Yumeko Jabami's visit to her in the hospital, she was shown to have become completely unresponsive and simply folds origami using money.

In the past, she portrays the traits of a kind girl with her main concern being her sister as she wants her to grow up a happy child. Like Yumeko, she finds some enjoyment in gambling, but seems to be more prone to nervousness. After winning a gamble, she crumbles in on herself once alone, relieved that she had won her first gamble of her high school career. She is also seen on edge around Kaibura Tsuibami when they first meet, but later accepts her as an acquaintance.

As shown, like her mother, aunt and sister, Souko had inherited the Jabami’s trait of having excellent gambling skills. As shown where Souko had exhibited immense observational skill, intelligence and cunning during her gamble again her aunt for control of the Jabami’s family and Yumeko, with Kabura noting that Souko was an exceptional Gambler.

As shown from her gamble against her aunt and after Kabura Tsuibami took legal guardianship of Yumeko, Souko deeply loves and cares for her sister and one of her deepest desires to continue staying together with her. With the thought and risk of losing her sister being enough to cause her enough mental anguish to cause her to have a full seizure, as shown during her gamble against her aunt. Later, after Kabura took Yumeko and forbade Souko from ever seeing her again unless she could return her Aunt’s loan of eight billion yen that Yumeko lost against Kabura, the mental stress from being separated from Yumeko and the depression of not having nearly enough resources to pay back the loan(and being rejected from being given any loans or assistance from the Momobami Family) eventually contributed to Souko becoming completely catatonic.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Past

Souko was raised alongside Yumeko by their aunt, Tsugiko, after the mysterious deaths of their parents. Tsugiko was both the guardian and the acting head of the Jabami family. She scolds Yumeko for her formality, urging her to be more familiar with her as the younger girl has been taught to be more polite by their aunt. She then hugs Yumeko, after telling her she wants the girl to grow up happy.[1]

It is implied by Kabura Tsuibami that Souko attended Hyakkaou to earn money as the Jabami family's finances have been depleted after the death of her parents. After winning her first gamble, Kabura reveals herself to her and begins a conversation about the Momobami family and their plans to take over Hyakkaou. They end up bonding as two girls who had their freedom taken away by the clan.

Tsugiko tells Souko and Yumeko that their parents were killed by unknown people. As Souko would become the head of the Jabami family once she became of age, Tsugiko seemed to want to take the position for herself and challenged Souko for the position as well as taking possession of Yumeko. The two play a Dice Gamble,[2] where, despite Souko trying her best, after a psychological warfare initiated by Tsugiko, Souko ends up losing against her. Souko collapses for a while, during which Yumeko gambles against Tsugiko in Souko's place and defeats her.[3] Afterwards, Yumeko gambles against Kabura and loses, meaning that Kabura is the one who has control over Yumeko, much to Souko's shock. This has led her being hospitalized after her defeat, suffering a mental breakdown. It is unknown if she was expelled by the family after losing.

She forgoes the black tie and has on accessories such as a purple hairband with a heart-patterned bow attached, and purple wrist cuffs with stripes on either one. She has bandages wrapped on either forearm and wears a white medical eyepatch over her left eye. She is also shown to have two piercings under her mouth, on the left side, one piercing on either ear and a tongue piercing.
Personality

Midaricrazy
Midari's masochism
Midari is a character with masochistic and suicidal tendencies, which is stated obviously in one of the chapters in the manga in which she stabs her own eye out with an ink pen to pay off the debt to the president. She is shown to be very persistent and overbearing, intimidating or being weird to the other students, such as when playing a sadistic game of life or death with Yumeko Jabami. Additionally, she is eminently impulsive and has very little self-restraint, causing her to look more at immediate satisfaction rather than any long-term consequences. Due to the fact that no one wants to play sadistic games with her, she is desperate to gamble with anyone and constantly awaits to 'get off', as stated in a chapter of the manga, by creating dangerous games where one player ends up dead.

MidariScissors
Midari excited to cut a thread of the guillotine
She even enjoys a game with Erimi Mushibami (one of the members from The Hundred Devouring Families) in which the risk is losing your finger, but turns out to be disappointed when the risk disappears. Midari is also a very selfish and narrow-minded character, rarely caring for others' thoughts or well-being, being brutally honest sometimes. She is never concerned with money when gambling, carelessly betting large sums with no worries about potential debt. She does not even clearly remember nor clarify before gambling how much money she owns. Instead, she says she seeks out the risk of being harmed. Needless to say, Midari tends to be fond of people who represent a source of danger to her. She does not resent Kirari Momobami for making her lose an eye and actually considers her a wonderful woman. Moreover, even when she is not personally affected, she hates people who consider suicide but are not ready to go through with it, as seen when she rescues Ayame Nureba.

MidariArrest
Midari acting out her duty as Beautification president
It has also been noted that, despite her bizarre behaviour, Midari is intelligent in academics, as seen in her flashbacks where she had won numerous awards, medals, and achievements in her middle school and elementary days. At the same time and as seen during some of her previous and present gambling matches, Midari has shown to be cunning and intelligent enough to make several subtle manipulations in order to sway them to go the way she wants. At the same time, she believes that studying a lot does not make someone a "genius", as noted in her criticism of Sayaka's behaviour. Midari also takes her role as Beautification council president quite serious although Ayame Nureba has said that she often skips Beautification Council meetings. She enjoyes her role as President mostly because it gives her the freedom to hold dangerous gambles.

MidariCrazy
Midari shouting at Jun to shoot her
After her plan to be killed was ruined, Midari developed an infatuation for Yumeko. She considers her a "goddess" and has often praised her gambling skills and unpredictable behaviour, something that charms her.

Rei Batsubami (×喰 零) is a major antagonist in Kakegurui XX. She was a former member of the Hundred Devouring Families that was banished by Kirari Momobami's family due to a past conflict within the clan.

Afterwards, Rei arrived to the Hyakkaou Private Academy, acting as a servant for the other members of her former clan, and identifying as male with an androgynous appearance, while secretly planning to avenge Yumeko Jabami's sister, and her family.

After being accepted back to the clan, Rei was able to finally free herself, and receive a new name.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:07

41:20

Rei is a biological teenage girl with a very androgynous appearance, having short light-brown hair with much longer styled bangs that cover the right side of her face, and empty dark-brown eyes. She wears white butler gloves with the standard male Hyakkaou Private Academy uniform; she also wears suspenders under her blazer. Rei seems to be the only member of her clan to wear glasses.

When she reveals her true self, she takes off her glasses, brushes her hair back with bangs that nearly cover her right eye, and multiple streaks which go around her head. She also opens up her blazer and removes her gloves revealing two tattoos that appear on the back of both of her hands. These tattoos are shaped like the "Bami" symbol crossed out. It is also shown that she no longer has empty dark eyes, which now have a lighter color and visible pupils.

After she was accepted back into the Hundred Devouring Families, she takes up a feminine appearance and wears the female uniform. Her hair is a bit twirlier now, she starts wearing pink lipstick, no longer has glasses, and her eyes don't appear empty anymore. In her hair, she wears the dragonfly brooch that she got from Yumeko Jabami's sister.

When Rei was younger, she used to have much longer hair with her bangs covering her right eye, and she wore a dark-blue dress with puffy sleeves. However, after Yumeko's sister suffered heavily at the hands of the Hundred Devouring Families, she cut her hair to the style she had during her debut.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

ReiCookies
Unsure how to react after being treated so kindly
Rei is a kind, helpful, polite and always serious person. While serving the other members of the clan, she often did not talk as she was nothing more a a servant to her distant cousins and only providing important information to others if they asked. Unlike most members of the family, Rei seems to be very sympathetic and compassionate toward others, which is demonstrated when Rei protects a "pet" girl who is bullied. Despite being serious, Rei is easily confused, especially when being praised or when someone is kind to her and does something nice for her due her essentially being treated as a object or servant by everyone around her since birth.

ReiRevenge
Rei wanting to get back what she lost
When she was a child serving as a house servant, Rei met a young girl who treated her very kindly — Yumeko Jabami's older sister, causing her for the first time to feel positive emotions due to someone complementing her and acknowledging her for the first time. But some time later, Yumeko's sister lost everything in the forced family civil war and became increasingly emaciated, which made Rei furious and raised her will to avenge her benefactor. It's the reason why she behaves very well with people, especially when it comes to the weak who are abused by others. She never really felt that she had a purpose in life except for helping others, and was always bound by these invisible chains to her clan. Rei also is very intelligent, having conceived the plan to become the head of the Hundred Devouring Families by subtly manipulating her cousins and taking advantage of them only seeing her as a object to plan behind their backs to her advantage. She eventually failed, but that experience has changed Rei, and at the end of the day she was free, confident, and happier with her life.

As a child, since Rei's family lost everything to the clan generations ago, she was treated as mere livestock and was essentially seen and treated as nothing more than a servant or object by her relatives. She was never acknowledged by others and had to clean, and serve them. But one day, Yumeko's sister came by the estate and gifted her a dragonfly brooch; she was the first one to treat Rei like a human. Whenever Rei saw her, she was happy. But one day, she was defeated by the clan as well, which caused Rei to become enraged, and cut her hair. At that moment she firmly decided to avenge her, and get back her place in the family.

Ayame Nureba (濡羽 綾女) is a deuteragonist in the spin-off series Kakegurui Midari. Though shy and insecure at first, she later experiences the thrilled side of gambling and becomes a member of the Beautification Council at the encouragement of Midari Ikishima.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Ayame has collarbone-length hair with two streaks on the sides of her head, where a small ponytail is tied by a white bow on the back. She has bangs hanging over her forehead. She wears semi-rimless glasses and a normal Hyakkaou uniform.

Yuuichi Hiiragi, the mangaka of Kakegurui Midari, replied to a fan on Twitter, saying that while there are no official colored artworks (at the time), he draws Ayame imagining her hair as brown and her eyes as red.[1]

For the release of Volume 4, a colored illustration of Ayame has been released.
Personality

Ayame seems to be a generally friendly girl who seems to be shy and honest, stating she doesn't want to make love to a stranger, but she gets into trouble easily and she also shows admiration for Yuriko Nishinotouin, thinking she's beautiful and elegant.

AyameMidariSync
Ayame acting like Midari
However, when she was forced into such a situation, she planned to take her own life, unable to find any other way to deal with her issues. She is very conflicted and insecure at times.

Later during the Hand Knife Trick game, she was almost driven to insanity and developed somewhat of a sadistic side, which she wants to pretend never happened. During the series, she often shows this trait, although as soon as a gamble is over she goes back to her usual reserved self. It seems to be almost like an alternate personality. She isn't particularly happy with Midari Ikishima's touchy-feel approaches and feels embarrassed when she hugs or touches her in some way.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Kakegurui Midari


Ayame attempting suicide.

Ayame's desperation after losing
Ayame is first seen losing a gamble and falling into debt against Nana Ootori. She plays again hoping to regain her money, but only ends up losing even more. Ootori states that her only option was to make money as a sort of prostitute for executives of a certain company. Horrified by that, Nureba sees no other way and goes on the school rooftop to commit suicide. She is confronted by Midari Ikishima who was apparently hanging out on the roof as well. She tells her not to do it, reminding her that it would make a mess and she'd cause troubles. Because Ayame is not listening, she proposes to gamble about her life. If Midari wins, Nureba can't kill herself. The challenge is for Midari to keep her from falling. So she pushes Ayame with her foot. Ayame gets scares and sees her life flash before her eyes. But in the last second, Midari sticks her hand out and Nureba reaches for it. Finally safe on the rooftop again, Midari screams at her for having no guts and still grabbing onto her hand out of human reflex. She leaves Ayame behind, who has to process what just happened.

Later, Ayame goes back to Ootori for one last game, since she doesn't want to sleep with some shady businessmen. Nana is cheating, however. Nureba realizes that she is about to lose, but luckily Midari steps in. Midari immediately realizes the game is not fair and proposes a hand knife trick game for the two to play. They need to stab in between Midari's finger as much as they can within a minute. Ootori starts and is fairly quick. Then it's Ayame's turn. Because she is so nervous and scared, she accidentally stabs Midari's finger. Nana is glad, thinking she just got into trouble for injuring the leader of the Beautification Council, but Midari screams at her to continue and stop being such a coward or finally kill herself. Ayame gets angry at her and decides she now wants to kill her. She proceeds to furiously stab between her fingers. Although she pierces Midari's hand a lot, she still continues. Ayame does this with death in her mind: since she knows what she would have to do if she lost, she basically fights for her life. Through all the pain, Midari gets infatuated.

AyameCrazy
Ayame enjoying to hurt Midari
Ayame gets faster and faster, with a smile on her face, as she loses her grip on sanity. One minute is over and she won by a large margin. Her debt is now erased and Midari asks her to join the Beautification Council, since she looked like she had fun. Ayame is embarrassed and doesn't know what to do, all the while Nana is totally freaked out.

AyameUnsure
Midari suggesting Ayame as a new member
Ayame keeps telling Midari to be more patient, since she can't make her decision yet on whether she should join the Council. Eventually, she agrees and they go there. They are greeted by Naoe Habakiri, the Vice-Beautification-President. Midari enthusiastically introduces her, while Ayame still doesn't like the idea of having actually enjoyed hurting Midari. Naoe is not pleased and declines Ayame as a new member. Midari proposes that they should gamble about that. Naoe agrees, but only if Midari leaves the Beautification Council in case of Ayame's loss. Nureba is confused since she hasn't got any money, but Midari pays her entrance fee. Now, Ayame has to gamble against Naoe if she wants to join. Quickly she ends up losing, but she has an idea and suggests to gamble more, betting Midari's social status. Unsurprisingly, Midari is quite happy and declares she will become the housepet of the Beautification Council, letting Naoe do anything she wants to her. Ironically, closing her eyes allows Ayame to see through Naoe's trick and win.

Kakegurui Twin


Eneru "fiding" Tsuzura as her next muse
Eneru shows up with Shimizu at the Literature Club gambling den, claiming ownership of it. Yukimi Togakushi and Tsuzura Hanatemari are shocked by her sudden arrival and try to convince her not to take the gambling den away, especially without a valid reason. Eneru, though, received formal authorization from Aoi Mibuomi who is a Student Council member and ignores them. Eventually, she accepts to let them stay for a week (during the school festival) if they manage to beat her. Her reason is not selfless at all: she has taken an interest in Tsuzura, thinking she is cute and would make a great motif to photograph. She then hugs her, making Tsuzura feel awkward. Yukimi pushes Eneru out of the way, which annoys her. In fact, as soon as they find out about the type of game it is, Yukimi reacts angrily.


Eneru threatening Yukimi to send her half-naked photos around the school
However, she is forced to accept to protect the club while Mary is away. The game she chose is overseen byInaho Yamato. It involves having to take pictures of the other players without being photographed by the others. In the game, players must take off a piece of clothing in every turn. Eneru clearly likes this game because it allows her to take photos of her opponent while she is in a state of undress.


Eneru losing to Yukimi and Tsuzura
In the first round, Eneru manages to snap a picture of Yukimi inside the maze and wins. While she is not very interested in her, she enjoys mocking her by making her see the embarrassing photos and even threatens to distribute them around the school for free just to ruin her reputation when Yukimi refuses to play along. She accepts to play once more, but only if Tsuzura is the model. In the end, this was a mistake because the two girls are able to defeat her. She is furious and even takes her mask off to scream, but Yukimi is able to take a topless photo of her and can now use her to blackmail her into revoking the confiscation of the Literature Club. Eneru is disappointed and horrified, scared of Aoi's reaction to her defeat.

She is later seen at the meeting of Full-Bloom along with Shimizu. During the school festival, she approaches Yumemi Yumemite on stage and challenges her to a gamble, wanting to take her position in the council.

Erimi Mushibami (蟲喰 恵利美) is a member of the Hundred Devouring Families, who arrived at Hyakkaou Private Academy in order to dethrone Kirari Momobami from her position of Student Council President, thus choosing a new leader for the clan. Her branch is specialized in the torture business.

She wears black dress with white accents in a Gothic Lolita style with dotted headband, black nails and she always carries her stuffed caterpillar around.
Personality

Erimi3
Erimi getting excited about choosing new leader of her clan.
Although she appears cute, Erimi is a devious gambler. But she's still very immature as she always drags her plushie with her. Because of that, others don't take her seriously and often make fun of her. She seems to have some issues regarding that and wants the others to respect her. Hence, when the others underestimated her, she was eager to make a first move against Yumeko Jabami, showing her slight recklessness and ego.

Erimi18
Erimi crying out of fear of losing her finger.
Since the Mushibami's family main business is torture, she has a great knowledge of it and overall, she is very sadistic. She enjoys seeing others suffer and has no problems with mentally scarring them. However, when she herself is in the slightest danger, she loses all composure and bursts into tears, being incredibly scared and showing she is actually quite a crybaby.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Kakegurui XX

Erimi16
Mocked by the other Momobamis
When Erimi arrived with her relatives, Midari quickly mocked her and called her a grade schooler. Even later when she announced her plans to become president, Miyo Inbami laughed it off and told her she shouldn't try to fight against the other members, since she has practically no chance. Ibara also laughs and tells her, how she should keep quiet about her plans anyway. She then told Rei Batsubami to organize a gamble with Yumeko Jabami and Midari Ikishima, hoping she would win and gain everyone's admiration and respect.

Erimi10
Erimi cutting threads of her guillotine.
Erimi used one of her torture machines as a gamble. She greeted them and explained it. In the game, one would put the finger in a guillotine and then cut off threads. Whoever takes their finger out first, loses. Erimi was surprised that Yumeko and Midari were so thrilled, but was sure, they would eventually get too scared. Erimi also joked about the observer possibly cheating, but to that she responded very seriously and told Erimi that she is absolutely neutral. They then went outside, while Inaho set the Guillotine up. During the game she herself, didn't have to worry, because she knew there was a metal plate, stopping the blade.

Erimi20
Erimi pulling out her finger
She waited for the others to back out, but they didn't. She knew from experience how mentally harming this game is to its victims. When Yumeko mentioned, that this game should be really enjoyable, she became paranoid, that Inaho Yamato, who prepared the threads, removed the metal plate, due to Yumeko's demand. From that point on, Erimi was extremely scared, but couldn't back out, since someone was observing and it was her idea. Eventually she started to cry, undignified. But their taunting, made her snap and she screamed and she madly cut the next thread.

Erimi21
Erimi upset about her loss
When there were only two threads left, Midari cut them both at once. Erimi quickly removed her finger, only to find the others still had theirs. Inaho didn't remove the plate and she worried about nothing. She lost the game. Midari was angry at her, for lying about the danger, but Yumeko told Midari off. She then took Erimi's hand and thanked her for the experience. Erimi was touched and felt remorse. Erimi realized how kind, and at the same time crazy, Yumeko was. She herself was out of the race, but knew, that Yumeko would be a strong opponent for the rest of her family.

Following Mary Saotome's defeat at the hands of Yumeko Jabami, the student council members hear about these news. During lunch time, Itsuki immediately followed Yumeko's trail in the school and somehow managed to get to her. She invites her to gamble with her, and while Ryota Suzui tries to halt Yumeko from gambling, she still wanted to gamble and accepts Itsuki's gamble invite. She invites her to play a game of "Double Concentration" in which the rules are fairly simple. 2 decks of cards will be used, making the total card usage of each game 104. Each player must then flip 2 cards of their choice in their turn. If they flip a pair of matching cards with the same suit and number, then they gain 2 points and the flipped cards are remained flipped open. If they flip cards that don't exactly match, then they lose a turn to the opponent. For their match, Itsuki places down 20 irregular colored chips which are worth 1 million yen each, making it a total of 20 million yen. For the betting, Itsuki uses all the 20 million worth chips, making their bet 20 million. Though Yumeko says she does not have the money, Itsuki assures her worries by saying she'll lend her 20 million.

ItsukiCry
Crying in fear after her defeat
Then, they begin to play. She wins the first round, even though both of them have a great memory. Yumeko really wants a second round but has no more money. So, Itsuki suggests Yumeko's nails as a bet. She shows them their nail collection, which she all got from people. She starts to act crazy. Yumeko accepts and Itsuki is sure she will win, since she has a trick up her sleeve where using her bag, some heat will reveal a pattern on her specially made cards that will disappear once the cards cool down. This makes her believe that she is unable to lose. However, Yumeko caught up on the trick and beats her. As Yumeko suggests to rip Itsuki's nails out, she cries. After her loss, she's expelled from the council.

When Yumemi Yumemite challenged Yumeko, Itsuki joined in to support her. She gifted her a chestnut cake and acted really sweet. But everyone knew, she was just trying to suck up to her. Then Itsuki admitted, that she needs her to get back on the council. Her father is a practical man and if she isn't powerful at the school he won't guarantee her a safe future. Yumeko has no problems with that and states they are friends.

ItsukiBlood
Ïtsuki ripping off her fingernails
Later when Yumeko challenged Kaede Manyuda, she was hoping that Yumeko would win. But then she needed more money and turned to her. She was hesitant at first but decided to lend her money. The bets got higher and higher. Itsuki knew that losing would mean her life was practically over. Enraged, she ripped off all of her nails and betted the amount of money her life was worth. After Yumeko ended up winning, she revealed that the two were planning this whole act in order to lower Kaede's guard. However, she didn't get back on the council after that.

entries.name: Kabura Tsuibami
entries.content:
Kabura Tsuibami (終喰 鏑) is a member of the Hundred Devouring Families and the head of Tsuibami clan.

After beating Yumeko in a gambling match when she was young, Kabura became an older sister figure to her when Yumeko came to be raised by the Tsuibami family.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2
Loading Pods
Loading ad 2/2
As a teen, Kabura appeared as a young girl of average height. She had wavy, shoulder-length blonde hair with brown roots and brown eyes. Her most noticeable features are tattoos on the outside of her arms, neck, and thighs. She also spots freckles on her face. She wore the standard Hyakkaou spring uniform, with her shirt having an opened collar.

As an adult, Kabura's outfit consists of a long dark cardigan with a pattern similar to a mandala, a tied crop top, leather bell bottoms, and black platform sandals. She spots many accessories, including bracelets, rings, and earrings. She keeps her hair tied in a loose bun and has fingernails and toenails painted in black.

While visiting Souko at the hospital with Yumeko, Kabura wore an all-black suit and black high heels with her hair kept in a loose ponytail.
Personality

Kabura is a tomboyish girl who at first seemed to have a kind personality, as shown when she sympathizes with Souko Jabami when they first met and becoming friends with her, but in reality, Kabura is a cruel and manipulative person, seeing Souko's face in complete desperation made her think on how it was 'the best face ever'. She also showed twisted perversion towards Tsugiko. As revealed by Kabura, much like with Yumeko, she was born with a mindset fundamentally different from the norm and has implied that she has always had sociopathic tendencies since she was little.

Realizing Yumeko’s abnormal skill and desire for gambling, Kabura manipulated Tsugiko and Souko into handing over Yumeko to her with the intent of raising her and nurturing her addiction to gambling.

Kabura's obsession towards Yumeko and her addiction to gambling may be filled by her own experiences, as the fellow "broken child". However, unlike Yumeko who appears to have signs of empathy and connections with her close family, particularly with her older sister, Kabura's main goals are just to simply relieve the boredom and act on her own desires, even if it means to hurt multiple people in the process.
ADVERTISEMENT
Profile

Kabura appears during Yumeko's flashback of her older sister in the past. A first year student attending Hyakkaou Academy, Kabura befriends fellow first year student Souko Jabami. Later meeting Souko’s aunt Tsugiko, Kabura lends Tsugiko over 8 billion yen in order to gamble with Souko for the title of head of their family. When Souko falls unconscious due to overwhelming panic and stress, Kabura watches as Tsugiko gambles with Yumeko, who takes Souko’s place, and is defeated by her. Realizing Yumeko potential, Kabura challenges Yumeko to a gambling match, and, should Yumeko lose, she would belong to the Tsuibami family. Yumeko happily accepts the challenge and is subsequently defeated by her opponent.

With Yumeko in her possession, she requests the Momobami family to not allow Souko Jabami to borrow money from them, as she wants to avoid any possibility of Souko winning back custody of her younger sister. She further explains to Kirari, the Momobami family head, that the Tsuibami family intends to raise Yumeko in an environment that will nurture her lust for gambling and further increase her skills, elaborating that Souko would not be a suitable guardian for her. In order to prevent Souko from influencing Yumeko, Kabura forbid them from seeing each other, and asks Kirari to forbid any loans from Momobami family for Souko.

Kabura would then raise Yumeko as her own younger sister. Eventually, the prolonged stress and suffering Souko endured caused her to suffer a full on psychological break. As implied by Kabura, she then had her committed to her current residence in a special ward in a university. Where she then finally allowed Yumeko to meet Souko again. After explaining to Yumeko the cause for Souko’s condition and stating how she was ultimately the cause of it, Kabura seeing Yumeko in a emotionally vulnerable moment, then encouraged Yumeko to be herself all the way and not be ashamed of herself, preventing Yumeko from feeling guilt for her sister’s condition and caused her to ultimately fully embraced her gambling addiction.

Kinu Shinobazu (不忍キヌ) is a representative of the Hyakkaou Academy Guardians Society, who was selected to gamble against newly formed Student Council in order to decide Kirari Momobami's fate.

Kinu is also a direct descendant of the 107th Hyakkaou's Valedictorian, who was her uncle.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Her body is slender. She has straight, light-colored hair styled into a high ponytail with long bangs framing her face. Her eyes are of a light color. She is wearing a flower-patterned bandana covering the lower half of her face. She also has many ear piercings. She is dressed in a sailor-style uniform with short sleeves, dark trim, and a ribbon detail on the chest.
Personality

Kinu was shown to be one of the shadier and vulgar members of the Guardians Society. As shown where she would rudely speak to her fellow Valedictorians and showcased a notable level of detachment from them, refusing to work together with them in the gambling battle against the New Student Council despite sharing the same goals and being on the same side.

Later, Kinu would show herself to be violent and short-tempered, as shown when she physically assaulted Yumeko when the latter refused her demands to gamble. Afterwards, Kinu even pulled out a knife and threatened to kill her if she didn’t comply. With her also showing intellect by first inviting Yumeko to an empty girl’s bathroom to isolate her and ensure that no one sees her get violent against her. However, despite her violent tendencies, it has been implied that Kinu does have limits to what she is willing to do. As shown where after Yumeko agreed to gamble with her by betting on whether she could stab her or not, Kinu was notably confused and outraged at the careless and reckless self-inflicted endangerment of Yumeko's life. Implying that Kinu was just trying to intimidate her into complying with her orders and wasn’t initially serious about killing her. Later, she would be disgusted by Yumeko’s gambling addiction and the sheer extent she would go to satisfy it that she would comply with Yumeko’s gamble and try to stab her for real, calling her a “degenerate” as she did so. Only prevented from doing so by Karen Mozu’s intervention.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Past

Kinu's uncle was the 107th Hyakkaou Valedictorian who started with day trading and ended up with a big fortune by venturing investments and purchasing companies. At some point, he was killed by someone who had grudge against him, causing Kinu to inherit his post.

Kokoro is a very mean person who does not care about housepets one bit and treating them horribly. She is devious and cheats during her games using her other followers. She is very confident and likes to gamble with others and make them her personal housepet. At the beginning of the Kakegurui story, Kokoro is overall almost identical to Mary Saotome herself.

Personality

Kurara is a very serious girl about her role as an election observer, but she is still very upbeat who appears to be somewhat smug and laughs when her impostor gets punished.

ImposterCry
The imposter crying after Runa Yomozuki enters
Her imposter seems to be quite devious, not shying away from faking an entire match, after she has likely been bribed. However once she is found out, her confidence drops and she becomes very nervous and scared. It is possible that she is much more cowardly when she is herself and can't hide behind the role of someone else.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Kakegurui XX

Kurara1
Talking with Inaho and Rumia
Kurara is first seen in the monitoring room, along with Inaho Yamato, Rumia Uru and the other observers, while they discuss Scumcoins. Kurara then heads off to oversee the gamble. As soon as Rin Obami, Mary Saotome, Nozomi Komabami, Ririka Momobami, Ibara Obami and Mary's friends have arrived, she explains the rules of the game, which is one suggested by Rin and called War. During the game she simply stands there and announces the results.

Kurara2
"Kurara" overseeing the gamble match.
At an unknown point in time, Rin and the imposter kept the real Kurara away from the scene, most likely by kidnapping, but the exact circumstances are unknown. The Impostor then dressed up as her. During her time, where she was disguised as Kurara, she most likely acted and looked the same as the real one. That must be the case since we see her around other election observers, who don't seem to notice anything strange. What happened to the real Kurara is yet unknown. She most likely got rescued by Runa Yomozuki after the game was over.

KuraraRin
Rin and the imposter laughing at the others
Because Ririka tricked him and his lies got exposed, Rin ends up losing with -269 points. Ririka questioned Rin, why he hasn't cheated at all. He then reveals, that the gamble only counts if an election observer is present. Everyone is shocked to learn, that it isn't the real Kurara Kurokura standing in the room, thus the match doesn't count. He then goes on how the election doesn't really matter, since Kirari Momobami is sure to win anyway. But Ririka had a voice call with Runa, head of the election committee, running the whole time.

ImpostorKurara
Runa and Kurara pranking the imposter
Runa then storms in and declares the match as valid, tossing Rin out of the election. The imposter is visibly nervous and starts to cry, most likely worrying about the punishment. Runa is angry and calls her a big faker. She is then seen being dragged away by Runa. The real Kurara and Runa then gang up on the imposter and threaten to punish her immensely. The imposter is extremely scared and cries uncontrollably.

Real Kurara
The real Kurara
But actually Runa was just kidding and presents her with an observer frog-themed hoodie. The two laugh at her for being so scared even though they were just joking. Despite what she had done, Runa must have realized that the imposter acts well as an observer and appointed her this duty for real.

The real Kurara finally appears during the Rock Paper Scissors Poker tournament, working as an observer. She wears a sash with the phrase "I am real" on it. There she explains the rules to everyone. She hands out the cards and declares the winners of each round. She is excited to open the second batch of games. Kurara is also confused by Midari Ikishima's weird behavior, especially when she gets excited becauseYumeko smiled at her. Kurara keeps on happily announcing how Miyo Inbami beats Mary every round, so that Mary even suspects her to work with Miyo for a moment. When Mary asks to use the bathroom, Kurara tells her she should rather hold it in. She is also naturally shook when Miyo takes a poisonous pill and threatens Mary.

Personality

Kurimu scaring Ayame Nureba
While Kurimu is a seemingly very nice and friendly girl at first, she can become rude and uncooperative very quickly, especially if someone tries to stop her fun. She's extremely selfish and interested in money and is willing to use any means to get it. As a leader, she presents herself as very strong and intimidating towards others, casually flipping people off and threatening violence, while still acting cheerful and cutesy.

However, she's not as scary as she may initially appear. While she owns a gun, she's not actually ready to kill, a fact that infuriates Midari Ikishima. Moreover, after seeing her crazy side Kurimu gets shocked and nervous, revealing to be less confident than she looked like.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Kakegurui Midari

Kurimu flips Midari off
Kurimu flipping Midari off
After Ayame Nureba is officially admitted into the Beautification Council, Midari Ikishima and she meet up with Kurimu to collect 17 million yen she still has to pay. As members of the council, it's their duty to deal with this type of students and make sure they pay their debts. Kurimu initially greets them cordially, but when Midari goes to the point she straight up refuses, uninterested even in solving the issue with a gamble.

KurumiGun
Kurimu suggesting Russian Roulette
However, when one of the delinquents pushes Ayame, she accidentally falls on her own suitcase, revealing the huge amount of money she's carrying around. This catches everyone's attention. Ayame is scared, but Midari calmly suggests to gamble: if Kurimu wins, she'll get Ayame's money; if she loses, she will pay 17 million yen to them. Kurimu accepts and takes a gun out of her bag, proposing a special game of Russian Roulette; Ayame will be her opponent.

KurimuCheat
Kurimu accusing Midari of cheating
After Kurimu's turn, when Midari questions the authenticity of the game, insinuating there is no bullet loaded, she immediately shoots, narrowly missing them. Ayame is clearly frightened and wants none of it. To her surprise, Midari is ecstatic. This is the first time she experiences a game of Russian Roulette and she's intrigued by the immense risk it poses. Since Ayame is too afraid to shoot herself, Midari makes her point the gun at her head instead. At this point, Ayame notices that Kurimu looks upset. Kurimu then tries to accused them of cheating, saying that it should have finally shot someone.

Midari and Terasumi
Midari threatens Kurimu, revealing her trick
When no bullet comes out after four attempts, Midari takes the gun from Ayame's hand and tries to shoot Kurimu, but it turns out to be empty. Kurimu was, in fact, cheating in an attempt to scare them and get the money, taking advantage of her knowledge of guns. The only bullet inside was the one she shot at them to pretend the game was legit. When the truth is revealed, Midari is furious and screams at her, calling her trash and criticizing her lack of guts, but Kurimu is too horrified to react. Before Midari leaves, she notes that she was really hoping to die.

Later, Kurimu meets up with Nana Ootori but refuses to get involved in her plans against Midari.

Personality

KakeguruiTwinGirl
Kurumi being cheery
Kurumi usually appears as a very cheery and upbeat girl who is full of energy and very confident. She also acts somewhat seductive and flirtatious at times, since she is aware of her attractive looks.

But beneath her quirky attitude, she has also been shown to be very cunning and manipulative. She quickly resorts to giving others money, if they agree to put themselves in risky situations, which she seems to enjoy. Kurumi is also a good gambler. She appears to be extremely intrigued by Mary Saotome's intelligence and skills and wants to assist to her matches. She claims not to care if Mary joins Full-Bloom or not.

It can also be seen by looking in the background of panels with Kurumi that she appears to be mimicking how the people around her stand and talk. This can be seen during the first literary club meeting with Kurumi, where she is copying how Yukimi sits and changes how she sits every time Yukimi moves so that they are matching, during the end of volume bonus in volume 8, where she is shown to be copying how Mary is standing and her mannerisms when talking to Nadeshiko Rurichou, and throughout the other gambles where members of the literary club are present, often mimicking how either Tsuzura or Yukimi are standing or sitting.
ADVERTISEMENT

Kakegurui Twin

Kurumyflirt
Kurumi's flirty behavior during the Couple game
Kurumi is first seen at the couple gambling game arranged by Sachiko Juraku. In the first round, she wants to make her confession to Haruto Kibashira, who accepts it. When the others want to leave, suspecting the boys are cheating, Kurumi happily lends them money. But she only will do so if they risk having to spend a night with one of the boys. The other girls accept and Kurumi interestingly follows the rest of the game.

KurumiMaryWhisper
Kurumi suggesting Sachiko's cheating
Since she finds Mary Saotome and her friends interesting, she later appears at Mary's gambling den while she is playing Doubt Poker against Sachiko. Because Mary has no more money, Kurumi lets her borrow some of hers, saying that thanks to her, she has gained quite a lot at the Coupling Party. Thus, Mary bets five million yen and keeps playing. Kurumi suggests that Sachiko may be cheating and Mary tries to find out how; however, Sachiko denies the use of any trick. Mary is eventually defeated, much to her humiliation. Kurumi can't lend her more money and Sachiko reveals that she was actually sent by Aoi Mibuomi to make Mary join Full-Bloom. Mary is suddenly forced to choose between becoming Sachiko's pet or joining Aoi's group that she despises.

KurumiMoney
Kurumi trying to convince Mary to let her join the club
Luckily, Mary is able to get away from this choice by winning with the help of Mikura at the Ougatou twins' gambling den. Kurumi shows up again, congratulating her for her success. Mary doesn't want to have any debt with her and tries to give her five million yen back, but she tells her that without that sum Mary and her friends would quickly become housepets. Kurumi agrees to forget about Mary's debt if they let her join the Literature Club. She explains that she is very interested in seeing Mary's abilities more, adding that she wants to see her reactions in every situation. They eventually agree, although Mary is quite irritated. Yukimi Togakushi and Tsuzura Hanatemari quickly take a liking to her and Kurumi has some good ideas to bring in more money.

Kurumi2
Kurumi dragging Mary with her
Together, they come up with a plan to gain a lot of money at the cultural festival. While Yukimi and Tsuzura run their own gambling den, Mary will challenge other dens on her own. Kurumi quickly joins her. During the school festival, she walks around with Mary and is excited to show her something. Mary still doesn't fully trust her, but Kurumi drags Mary with her. They almost run into Ririka Momobami. Kurumi then brings Mary to Nadeshiko Rurichou (a friend of Kurimi) where they then gamble against her. When Mary wants to leave, Kurumi reminds Nadeshiko of all the things she could win, so they both plead for Mary to stay. After that game, Kurumi observes Nagi Kamishimo and Mary's game. Mikoto has long, two-colored hair tied with a turquoise hairpin. While the majority of her hair is brown, the tendrils around her face are blonde. Her eyes are sea blue with narrow pupils, similar to Sachiko Juraku. Mikoto wears the standard female middle school uniform: a long-sleeved white blouse with a black blazer and a much longer skirt than most female students, reaching just above her ankles. She also wears white socks and black ballet flats. Her nails are painted in turquoise.
Personality

Mikoto appears to be brash, cocky, and quite daring. Despite being a trial student at high school as a middle schooler, she has no issues calling out her older colleagues for cheating, even violent ones like Jun Kiwatari, who is way larger and heavier than her, knocking him out while he attempted to attack her. At times, she can lose her temper and threaten others as well, which happened a lot with Mary Saotome.

Aside from Yua's calm, and Shougou's cool and calculative personalities, Mikoto is the muscle of the trio. Although, her tough exterior could be explained as a wall that protects her and Shougou from the consequences of not coming from money in a school filled with the most financially and politically powerful students in Japan.

Mikoto is especially protective of Shougou who has been her best friend since elementary school. She was visibly distressed when she discovered him getting hit by other students. They both decided to study hard in order to pursue education at prestigous Hyakkaou Private Academy in order to change their social standing, which is a counterpart of Mary and Tsuzura's dream to become 'winners'.

Mikura has shown great loyalty, dedication, and subservience to Sachiko Juraku by doing everything for her. Sachiko treats her brutally, but some of this treatment appears to amuse Mikura. In addition, she thinks little of insignificant gamblers and learns a lot about gambling from her master, as she enjoys watching them lose.

Mary and Mikura promising to respect each other.

She suggests to go to Naoko and Houko's gambling den, where they can gamble without money. Mikura then gambles with Mary Saotome during the Hidden Rule Game, since Ouri threatens all of them. During the game, Mikura gets desperate, thinking back to her time before being Sachiko's housepet. Mary feels sorry for her and gives her best to win. After the game Mikura learns to respect Mary and the two create somewhat of a bond between them.

Miri Yobami (陽喰 三理) is a member of the Hundred Devouring Families, who arrived at Hyakkaou Private Academy in order to dethrone Kirari Momobami from her position of Student Council President, thus choosing a new leader for the clan. Miri's and Miyo Inbami's families are specialized in medicine business (including poisons), being responsible for a conflict between other branches.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:06

41:20

Miri is a girl of a short stature with dark blue hair that is styled into two odango buns, empty dark blue eyes and her makeup is a red eye shadow in the corners of her eyes, which is similar to Miyo Inbami.

She wears the standard female Hyakkaou Private Academy issued uniform.
Personality

Miri34
Miri and Miyo as kids
She is reserved with her affections; unlike Miyo, Miri didn't want to hug Yumeko Jabami upon meeting her, although that might have been because of Miyo's poison. Most of the time, Miri is extremely serious about what she's doing. Similar to Kirari Momobami, Miri is unsympathetic for the lives of others; during the game with Yumeko, she had no problem putting the others' life at risk and played strategically.

However, she does care about her sister, putting her life above herself. Miri is able to communicate with Miyo through subtle gestures and have full conversations, a skill they had developed in their friendship during childhood. To other people she stays distant, only speaking in terse sentences. After her and Miyo's families were split, they were separated and that was soon the only way they could communicate.

While she seems cold towards everyone, including her sister, she was willing to risk her life for Miyo, no matter if her sister threatened her or not.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Past

At a certain point, the Inbami and Yobami families both ran out of potential heirs. In order to secure their positions in the Momobami clan and maintain their businesses, they decided to name Miyo and Miri as their respective clan heads, which separated them from each other. Being very close, both sisters couldn't stand this treatment, so they decided to create their own sign language in order to communicate during family meetings, as normal talking was strictly forbidden to them.

Kakegurui XX

Miri4
Miri and Miyo after defeating Yuriko
Miri arrived with the other family members during the presidential election. She warned Erimi, that getting to the top would just turn her into a target for the others. Together with Miyo, they then played and won against Yuriko Nishinotouin, having poisoning her. She also noted how fragile Yuriko was and that she broke down too easily. Miri and Miyo got paired up with Yumeko Jabami and Ryota Suzui to play Nim Type Zero.

Miri16
Miri refusing to hug Yumeko
Before the game, she made clear, that they are enemies and renounced all formalities. Later she even avoided returning Yumeko's looks. Miri was annoyed when Ryota also joined into the game, but said nothing. She exchanged, what her cards were to Miyo, using their signs. Miri played a zero in the first round, but did not do anything particular. When Yumeko had to step out due to the poison, Miri didn't care. Then Miyo suggested, that the next loser will have to poke themselves with a poison needle.

Miri8
Miri during match against Mary Saotome and Ryota Suzui
During the next round, Mary Saotome told Ryota to show everyone his cards. He trusted her, but Miri believed it was very foolish. Despite colluding with her sister, she ended up losing and had to poke herself. During the next round, Miri was forced to bet a lot of serve chips, meaning she couldn't recover from a loss. Later, they realized how Mary tricked them, but at that point, the poison already got to her. She would have been able to survive, but that would have meant Miyo's loss. After Miyo coldly commanded her to lose on purpose, she did it.

Miri14
Miri before fainting, due to the poison
The game was over and with all her votes lost, Miri was out of the race. She fell unconscious, but Miyo stung Miri's finger for her. Then she brought her to a hospital. She is later seen well again at the auction along with the others. There she notes, how foolish it was of them to never consider Rei turning on them. Miri also doesn't partake in any gambling anymore, but she does follow the election and is worried about Miyo's game against Mary during the Grand Tournament.

She wears black gloves with the standard female Hyakkaou Private Academy issued uniform.
Personality

Miro5
Miroslava's fierce demeanor.
Miroslava is a very stoic and level-headed person who never rushes things and she is usually quiet when she thinks about the next move, making her a worthy opponent. Miroslava plans ahead a lot and sees a lot of potential in Yumeko Jabami, showing she's also fairly intelligent and perceptive. Just like other members of her family, she really wants to get rid of Kirari and Ririka Momobami.

Despite this, she doesn't possess a great interest in being president herself and believes that no one would be better fit for the position than Terano Totobami. Miroslava actually has a very friendly side, which doesn't come out too often. She isn't a good schemer and was impressed by Itsuki Sumeragi tricking her. As revealed by Kirari, Miroslave herself isn’t a very good gambler and has a tendency of showing all her emotions in her face, making her easily readable and predictable in a game.
ADVERTISEMENT

Profile

Miro4
Miroslava discussing with other clan members about Yumeko.
Kakegurui XX

A young Miroslava is seen with the other children in the family.[1]

Miroslava arrived with the other Hundred Devouring Families, during the presidential election. While her relatives were discussing other things, she was the first to point out Yumeko Jabami and also proposed to add her into the plan. But Terano Totobami doesn't find her important. Later she also remarks, how Miyo Inbami and Miri Yubami started the whole war between the families. She then goes on to gamble, gaining 17 votes.[2]

ÏbaraMiro
Miroslava and Ibara ready to devour Yumeko.
She and Ibara Obami later get invited to the Greater Good Game by Terano.[3] She makes it clear, that not all of them win and acts overall very strategically. In the first round, she found a note by Itsuki Sumeragi along with her coins.[4] Miroslava can take Itsuki's coins for her personal box and the two should work together as traitors and pay no taxes.

MiroCheat
Miroslava getting a note from Itsuki.
When the traitors are brought up during the discussion, she suggests that she can get the truth out of the traitor in five minutes, stating that she also knows stuff about torture. Ibara declines this, since she herself could be the traitor and then it would be pointless.[5]

MiraIbara
Miroslava arguing with Ibara.
After the next round, Miroslava states that the two traitors must be working together since not doing so would not be beneficial to anyone. Kaede Manyuda and Yumeko then act as if they were the traitor and threatened not to pay any coins. Miroslava was worried so she decided to pay all of her coins. That was the final round and she was currently in the lead. However Kaede deducts that she and Itsuki must be the two traitors. Miroslava is then expelled from the game by the others.

Mirattack
Miroslava ambushing Itsuki for being tricked and expelled by her.
She realized Itsuki planned for her to be found out and felt betrayed. She is upset at Itsuki at first and pushes her to the wall. She fists out, but stops. She notes how scheming isn't her specialty and is impressed by Itsuki making her dance in her palm. And then she also realizes, that Itsuki didn't do it to win herself, but rather for Kaede.[6]

MiroslavaNice
Miroslava wishing Itsuki luck with Kaede.
Miroslava promises to keep Itsuki's crush on him a secret. She is surprised of being able to talk so friendly with a former competitor and rethinks what true gambling means. Miroslava accepted her defeat and happily hands her votes over to Terano, stating that she hopes she will beat Kirari Momobami.

Later, she is present at the auction and annoyed, that Ibara let the others notice them, as she had told him not to make any big bets. She is surprised and worried that Rei Batsubami might take over the entire clan. She knew that it would only get harder for them to become president if Rei gets that many votes. She also appears in Rei Batsubami’s flashback, playing hide and seek with Ibara Obami. She then tells the other family members about the grand tournament that Sayaka organized and mentions how it's most likely a scheme to pool all the votes.[7]

She is seen discussing the outcome with the other family members.[8]

She is notified by Terano about Kirari's gamble.

She is surprised to see Yumeko giving away her votes
